yaml.title: STAT 579: Final Project Hub
yaml.subtitle: Your Central Resource for the Target Trial Challenge

markdown.markdown:
Welcome to the central hub for the STAT 579 final project. This page contains everything you need to successfully complete your target trial emulation, from initial guidelines to final grading rubrics. Please bookmark this page and refer to it often throughout the semester.

The goal of this project is to give you hands-on experience in conducting a causal inference study from start to finish. You will pose a causal question, design a hypothetical "target trial" to answer it, and then use real-world observational data to emulate that trial. This process will challenge you to be rigorous, thoughtful, and transparent about your assumptions.


Keep these major deadlines on your calendar. A more detailed week-by-week schedule with smaller deliverables is available in the detailed schedule linked below.

| Deliverable | Due Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Project Proposal** | End of Week 9 |
| **Final Presentation** | In Class, Week 14 |
| **Final Paper** | End of Finals Week |

## Project Resources & Links 📂

Here are the essential documents for your project. I recommend approaching them in the order listed.

- [**Project Guidlines**](project/project_guidelines.qmd)
	- **Start here.** This document provides a high-level overview of the project's core objective, deliverables, and overall expectations.
- [**Prject Schedule**](project/project_schedule.qmd)
	- **Your roadmap.** This file breaks the project into manageable weekly tasks and deliverables, aligning your work with the course topics.
- [**Data Resources and Exploration**](project/data_resources.qmd)
	- **Find your data.** Use this page to access data search tools and a curated list of datasets that are well-suited for target trial emulation.
- [**Proposal Template**](project/proposal_template.qmd)
	- **Your proposal blueprint.** A template to help you structure your project proposal, which is the first major graded deliverable.
- [**Proposal Rubric**](project/rubric_proposal.qmd)
	- **How your proposal will be graded.** The detailed rubric for the project proposal.
- [**Final Paper Rubric**](project/rubric_final_paper.qmd)
	- **How your final paper will be graded.** The detailed rubric for the final written report.

Good luck, and please don't hesitate to use office hours to discuss your project ideas.
